crossRefs.note: “Now, my God, let, I beg you, your eyes be open, and let your ears be attentive, to the prayer that is made in this…
He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are…
I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.
Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.
Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.
Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
“Now therefore, our God, listen to the prayer of your servant, and to his petitions, and cause your face to shine on…
For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against…
It may be Yahweh your God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to defy the…
It may be that Yahweh will look on the wrong done to me, and that Yahweh will repay me good for the cursing of me…
But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.
How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.
Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.
Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.

parallels.note: Incline your ear, Yahweh, and hear. Open your eyes, Yahweh, and see. Hear the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent…

translations.web: Turn your ear, Yahweh, and hear. Open your eyes, Yahweh, and behold. Hear all of the words of Sennacherib, who has sent to defy the living God.
translations.bsb: Incline Your ear, O LORD, and hear; open Your eyes, O LORD, and see. Listen to all the words that Sennacherib has sent to defy the living God.
translations.kjv: Incline thine ear, O LORD, and hear; open thine eyes, O LORD, and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent to reproach the living God.
translations.asv: Incline thine ear, O Jehovah, and hear; open thine eyes, O Jehovah, and see; and hear all the words of Sennacherib, who hath sent to defy the living God.
